features: DATABASE CHANGES: ELEVEN MIGRATIONS AND TWO SETTINGS MIGRATIONS, SEVEN OF THEM WRITE DATA — The update runs eleven new migrations and two settings migrations by itself. New structures: for each communication the date and time it goes out by itself, who scheduled it and when it went out; for each report who assigned it and when; on the succession the choice about the deceased's interest after the death and the choices about the heirs' interest changed for that succession; in the settings of each condominium the eight choices about the heirs' interest; for each purchase invoice its management. They write data: one fills in the publication date of the communications already published (the date they were written); three create the new email preferences (scheduled communication, assigned report, deleted comment), equal to the ones each user already has for the nearest notice; one clears the assignments of the reports that existed before, which no page let you choose; one gives the successions already recorded the default choice about the deceased's interest; one fills in the management of the purchase invoices already recorded, from their accounting entry and their items. Of the settings migrations: one adds two switches about assigning reports, both off; the other changes «Kondomanager» into «KondoManager» in the application name and in the sender name of the emails, if they were written that way. One new permission, «Assegna segnalazioni» (assign reports); the update realigns the default roles by itself. The requirements do not change. After the update reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGED: SUCCESSIONS ALREADY RECORDED AND THE DECEASED'S INTEREST — In each succession you choose what happens to the deceased's interest after the death: «si fermano al decesso» (stop at the death) or «continuano a suo nome» (continue in his or her name). By default, with the arrears passed to the heirs they stop; with the arrears left in the deceased's name they continue. The successions already recorded take the default choice of their path: with the arrears passed to the heirs, the interest proposal for the deceased now stops at the death, also for the ones recorded before. The interest from the death onwards is proposed by each heir's position, for his or her share (see the next entry).

CHANGED: THE INTEREST ON INHERITED DEBT — From the day of the death the interest proposal calculates for the heirs, by share, the interest on the debt they inherited, until that debt enters one of their issued instalments. The successions already recorded have the heirs' lines straight away. In «Recupero dei crediti» (debt recovery) of the condominium you decide, with the recommended choices already set, eight things: whether to count interest also on the interest already charged to the deceased, the first day, the «Interessi dopo la scadenza» (interest after the due date) of the new instalment, whether the debt goes down instalment by instalment, whether an heir's payment covers the inherited debt first, whether the deceased's repayment agreement in good standing counts, the days up to the due date of the new instalment with «continuano a suo nome» (continue in his or her name), and whether the deceased's interest recorded after the succession passes to the heirs. The same choices can be changed for a single succession from its page, with «Cambia per questa successione» (change for this succession), which saves only the ones you changed. With «Cambia» (change) in the proposal window you change the amount or the rate of a line, always and only downwards, with the reason (with a changed rate the reason says «1.00 % a year, chosen by the administrator, reduced from the 2.00 % a year, art. 12 of the regulation» and the account statement the rate); next to the amount of each line there is the percentage.

CHANGED: «RATE SCADUTE», REMINDERS AND LETTERS WITH THE HEIRS — After a succession the inherited debt moves from the deceased to the heirs in «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments), in the reminders and letters, in the six months to act, in the treasury and in the file for the lawyer: the heirs have their own line with the label «ereditato» (inherited) and the note «from Mario Rossi, succession of …». The total does not change, and the balances not yet in a plan are no longer counted twice. The line stays as long as its interest runs, also after the new instalment is issued, but at most for what is still to be paid on that instalment: an heir who has already covered it, with a payment or with a credit of his or her own such as the adjustment, no longer has the line; with «Su più rate, scende rata per rata» (instalment by instalment) off, the debt leaves «Rate scadute» at the first new instalment. Whoever inherited from an heir who died in turn continues the chain: the heir who dies stops counting and from there his or her own heir counts. Account statements do not change; the positions of the financial statement and the journal leave the debt in the name of the deceased until you offset it with the credit the heirs' plan gives him or her, and the positions guide explains it.

CHANGED: AN HEIR'S PAYMENT — The heir who pays the inherited debt records it in his or her own name, in the line «Debito ereditato da …» (debt inherited from …), even without other instalments: the payment covers his or her share, and the next plan does not ask for it again. On the deceased's instalment, after the succession, the program warns you and suggests recording it to the heirs, by share if the transfer comes from the deceased's account. With «Resta a …» (stays with …) and «Versato da» (paid by) an heir, the payment stays with the deceased, in the pages and in the proposal as in the journal and in the plan. If the plan has already absorbed the arrears, a payment on the deceased's instalment stops with a sentence that says where to collect it; if however the heir is chosen as the payer on that instalment, the refusal still points to the line «Debito ereditato da …», which by then no longer exists: the payment is recorded on his or her new instalment. The pair of movements that an heir's payment writes in the Wallet cannot be edited or deleted by hand: it is removed by reversing the collection.

CHANGED: THE COLLECTION DETAIL AND THE RECEIPT — The collection detail has the total at the top next to the status; for an heir's payment it says the heir who paid (no longer the deceased's name with «Versato da» the heir), with the breakdown «Sul debito ereditato» (on the inherited debt) and «Sulle sue rate» (on his or her instalments), and in the collections list the «Soggetto» column says the same name. The «Crediti da riallineare» (credits to realign) box and the labels of the instalments table are in plain words («Denaro versato», «Credito pregresso»). The receipt of an heir's payment is made out by default to the heir, with «Per il debito ereditato da …» (for the debt inherited from …); when the heir pays from the line «Debito ereditato da …» of a single deceased you can make it out to the heirs or to the deceased, in the inherited-debt box. Receipts already issued do not change.

CHANGED: INVOICES REMEMBER THEIR MANAGEMENT — Each purchase invoice remembers the management it belongs to. «Edit» starts from the invoice's management and keeps «Fuori preventivo» (outside the budget), instead of moving the entry to the ordinary management; the items you can choose are those of the invoice's management, and an item of another management is refused, in editing as in registration. «Finanzia spesa» (finance the expense) opens the instalment plan on the invoice's management and no longer on the first one. For the invoices already recorded the update fills in the management from their accounting entry or, without one, from their items when they all belong to one management. In the invoices list a read-only check shows the ones an old edit moved; the correction never runs by itself: you make it, with «Riporta com'era» (restore as it was): a moved invoice is restored only if it has no payments, is outside the instalment plans and is in an open financial year; the «Fuori preventivo» mark removed by an old edit is put back also on a paid invoice, but not in a closed financial year.

CHANGED: THE EMAIL PREFERENCES — «Comment deleted or hidden» becomes two preferences, «Comment hidden» and «Comment deleted», for reports and for communications: the new one is on for whoever has the old one on. «Scheduled communication published», like «Noticeboard communication approved», and «Ticket assigned», like «New fault report», are also new. Whoever approves the attachments of the communications, and not those of the reports, now sees «Attachment awaiting approval»; whoever uploads attachments only in communications sees «Attachment approved» and «Attachment deleted». They have to be turned on, because they start off.

CHANGED: THE NAME IN THE EMAILS — The title of the emails carries the name of the firm you wrote in the printing page and, if there is none, the application name; so does the signature, except in receipts, letters, adjustment sheets and offset notices, which have their own closing; at the bottom there is «Sent with KondoManager, open source software for condominium management». «Kondomanager» written that way in the application and sender name becomes «KondoManager». The subject of the invitation and welcome emails of an account keeps the application name.

CHANGED: THE LOCATION IS REMOVED FROM PHOTOS — Every JPG, PNG or WebP photo you upload to the program (attachments, an invoice document, the proof of a letter, a repayment agreement, minutes) loses the location, the phone model and the other photo data, even if it comes from a computer; only the orientation stays, so an upright photo does not show up sideways. The size limit counts on the cleaned file. A photo the program cannot clean is refused with a sentence. A «moving photo» loses the video at the end. PDFs do not change. The photos already uploaded with the earlier versions stay as they were, with their location: if needed, upload them again.
CHANGED: THE ASSIGNED REPORT — The reports assigned before this version, which no page let you choose, lose the assignment: from now on you assign from the report page.

CHANGED: THE DELETED COMMENT NOTICE — Whoever writes a comment receives an email also when you delete it (the preference «Comment deleted»), with the date, the report or communication and the first words of the comment; for a comment awaiting approval it says «it was not published». It also goes out for an already hidden comment, one per comment also in bulk, and does not go out if the author deletes his or her own. On the «Comments» page the confirmation of «Delete» says the author receives an email.
CHANGED: MENUS CLOSE AFTER THE CHOICE — In the single-choice drop-down menus of the program, once you pick an item the menu closes instead of staying open or flipping.

NEW: SCHEDULED PUBLICATION OF COMMUNICATIONS — In the communication form, at the status field choose «Scheduled» and write the day and time it goes out by itself. Until then the condominium owners do not see it and receive nothing; at that time it becomes published and the notices go out, as if you had published it yourself. The time is in the installation's time zone, and the form writes it next to the date only if it is different from the Italian one. In the list the communication has «Scheduled» with the date, and the page says «Scheduled for …». When it goes out, whoever scheduled it receives a confirmation email, if he or she still has «Publish communications» and has the preference «Scheduled communication published» on. The server's scheduler must run every minute (the cron or the «Automazione cloud» setting): if it is stopped at the chosen time, the communication goes out as soon as it restarts, late and with the notices, and the form warns you if at that moment the scheduler does not appear active. Whoever has «Publish communications» schedules, from the panel, an approved communication. From the list, removing the approval from a scheduled communication also removes the date (the window says so): it stays awaiting approval, and if you approve it again it goes out at once.

NEW: ASSIGNING REPORTS — From the page of a report, whoever has the permission «Assegna segnalazioni» (assign reports; by default the administrator and the collaborator) assigns it to himself or herself with «Assign to me», to another user of the panel, or leaves it with nobody; the page says «Assigned by … on … at …». Whoever receives it gets an email if he or she has the preference «Ticket assigned» on and did not assign it himself or herself; whoever loses it, when you reassign it or leave it with nobody, gets one too, on the same conditions and if he or she can still enter the panel (not someone who is suspended). Whoever follows a report also receives the condominium owners' replies. In the list there is the filter «Assigned to» (with «To me» and «Unassigned») and under the title «assigned to …». In the general settings you choose whether the owner sees who follows his or her report and whether assigning it moves an open report to «In progress»: by default both off. The field «Assigned to» is also in «Create ticket» of the panel.

NEW: THE ACTION INBOX KNOWS WHO A REPORT IS ASSIGNED TO — On the row of a report's task there is «assigned to you», «assigned to Anna Neri» or «not assigned»; the filter «Le mie» (mine), with its number, shows only the tasks of the reports you follow and is remembered in the page address.

NEW: STATUS AND PRIORITY FROM THE REPORT PAGE — From the page you change the priority with one click and the status with the menu, the same way as «Edit»: changing the status sends no email. «Closed» asks for confirmation and says no email goes out.

NEW: THE PHOTO FROM THE PHONE — On phones and tablets, next to «Add attachments» there is the «Photo» button, which opens the camera: in reports and communications, in the panel and in the portal. The photo is shrunk before sending to 1,600 points on the long side and loses the location; a photo taken gets its own name, with the date and time. On computers the button is not there.

NEW: LATE-PAYMENT INTEREST AND THE INCOME ITEM — The new income items of the chart of accounts (for example «Interessi di mora», late-payment interest) go into the master account «Entrate e proventi» (income). When a management has no income item to receive the interest, the proposal says so at the top, with the link to the management's chart of accounts; an income item may have a zero budget. On the chart of accounts page a read-only check shows the income items created earlier and ended up in the costs master account; the correction moves only the item's master account, for the future.

NEW: THE INSTALMENT PLAN OF AN OUT-OF-BUDGET EXPENSE — In the new instalment plan the two tabs are called «Dalle voci del preventivo» (from the budget items) and «Spese fuori preventivo» (out-of-budget expenses), and the cart is per management: the program refuses an invoice of another management. When the cart is empty it says «Nessuna fattura da mettere a rate qui» (no invoice to put into instalments here), what the tab contains and what does not show here (an invoice on a budget item, of another financial year, already in another plan, with its name), with the link to the right tab. The error messages name the fields as you see them on screen and in plain words, and the button says «Scegli almeno una fattura per salvare» (choose at least one invoice to save). A plan that starts at € 0.00 (for example because an overspent item has the year-end adjustment off) says so before saving. «Piano Rata Integrativa» is now a label, «Rata integrativa», next to the plan.

NEW: THE «CONFIGURA NUOVA VOCE DI SPESA» WINDOW — In an out-of-budget expense with urgency the supporting document stays with every strategy, including «Usa fondo riserva» (use reserve fund), and reopens after a refusal; with the resolution the chosen strategy stays and the fund is really used (with the same coverage as the overspend, and without the fund if the invoice has a line charged to a single unit); the destination says the invoice's management, also for an extraordinary one; with the urgency the overspend window still opens for the other lines, and the overspend recorded is that of the whole invoice; a line charged to a single unit does not count on the chapter; the Dashboard recognises the items born from «Fuori preventivo» by a real mark, no longer by the name starting with «Imprevisto -». The invoices already recorded with the resolution in earlier versions do not have the window's data: for them the Dashboard still proposes «Finanzia spesa» (finance the expense).

NEW: THE FOUR THINGS OF THE REPAYMENT AGREEMENT AND OF THE PROPOSAL — In the window of the interest proposal the instalments already in an agreement are switched off with «È già nell'accordo del …» (already in the agreement of …); the sentence of «remain suspended» says what happens; «Togli la persona» (remove the person) leaves the line switched off with «Rimetti la persona» (put the person back); and with no income item the proposal says so at the top.

NEW: THE NUMBER NEXT TO «COMMENTS» AND THE «CONDOMINIUM» COLUMN — The report page counts the published comments and the ones awaiting approval that you can read, never the hidden ones, like the list and the communication page. On the «Comments» page, for the discussion of a communication to persons, the «Condominium» column says the person's condominium and no longer his or her name, which goes under the title: «discussion with Lucia Verdi».

NEW: CLEARER ATTACHMENTS — In the creation forms the size limit is the real one («at most 20 MB per file») and the formats allowed are the real ones; the «N / maximum» box counts all the files of the item, and when you see fewer, under the list there is «You can see 2 of 3: the others are not visible to you.»; the subtitle of «General settings» is in Italian, and Spanish has its entries translated.

NEW: THE DARK THEME AND THE PHONE — The portal pages (events, documents, reports, communications) have the dark theme colours where they were missing, the value chosen in the menus can be read in the dark theme, and the text of the fields is 16 points on touch.

FIXED: THE ICONS ON THE PHONE — On phones the icons of the comments (also «Approve» and «Show again») and the bins of the rows always appear, no longer only when the mouse passes over, which touch does not do. The same for the bin of a supplier's debt, the one of the invoice rows and «Annulla emissione» (cancel issue) of the instalment plans.
FIXED: LATE-PAYMENT INTEREST WITH SEVERAL PAYMENTS — Recording the same credit in two times no longer covers the same days twice (the difference was a few cents).

FIXED: THE GUIDES — The guides on positions, «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments), change of ownership, debt recovery, collection, the condominium dashboard, invoice registration, the instalment plan and the Action inbox say how heirs, the out-of-budget invoice and the «Le mie» (mine) filter work today.
